results.title: Depost AI — The LinkedIn AI agent for B2B marketers
results.content:
## Fifteen minutes from sign-up to strategy.

Connect a LinkedIn account. Onboarding reads the profile and the last 50+ posts, then hands you a strategy to confirm.

 Who you write for, what you lead with, what posts should bring you
 Your content measured against it: what worked, what to change
 Five ideas, each with the evidence it rests on

What you confirm becomes the brand memory every agent reads.

Buyers trust people, not logos: 82% of B2B buyers say content from creators influences what they buy. LinkedIn research, 2025

## Four specialists, one loop.

Fixed names, fixed jobs, in loop order, chaining 75+ content operations into every plan. Each agent hands its work to the next, and everything ends in your approval queue.

Performance Analyzer [...] ## A few things worth knowing.

The things people ask before they connect an account. For anything else, write to support@depost.ai.

Ask AI     ChatGPT    ·   Claude    ·   Perplexity    ·   AI Mode    ·   Grok

Will this get my LinkedIn account restricted? 

No. Publishing goes through LinkedIn’s official API, and your analytics come from the LinkedIn account you connect: your own data. Depost AI sends no automated DMs, connection requests, or comments: the things that actually get accounts flagged.

  Will the posts sound like AI? 

The Post Generator writes in a voice learned from your own posts and re-learned weekly. And nothing publishes without your approval, so your worst case is an edit, not an incident.

  Do the agents post without me? [...] in your voice

Voice is re-learned from your recent posts weekly, so it drifts with you, not away from you.

Graphic Generator

### The graphic is already designed.

Infographics and visuals generated to match your visual brand: your colors, your themes, learned from what you've published. The post and its graphic arrive together, ready to schedule as one.

Draft: 3 hiring mistakes

2.1×

on brand, ready to post

On-brand by default. Your infographic comes out looking like yours, not stock AI output.

Scheduling, built in

### From approved to published, without you.

Approved drafts flow into your queue and publish through LinkedIn’s official API at the times that work for your audience: first comment written for you, failures flagged to your inbox.
